parameters.text:

Job Requirements:
{{ $("Analyze Job Requirements").item.json.output }}

Candidate Profile:
Name: {{ $json.fullName }}
Email: {{ $json.email }}
CV Version: {{ $json.cvVersion }}

Provide:
- fitScore (0-100)
- matchedStrengths (array of strings)
- missingSkills (array of strings)
- riskyGaps (array of strings)
- recommendation (APPLY / UPDATE_CV / SKIP)
- reasoning (brief explanation)
- cvImprovements (object with canAddNow, needToLearn, doNotClaim arrays)
